role: direct image-reader work observations; not formal B audit
coordinate_note: All observed bounds are approximate top-left source/full-preview pixels; observed grid dimensions are columns,rows. Exact spec rectangles are marked separately and are not visual measurements. Approximate frame borders generally +/-3px, art +/-6px.

observations.detail: Both upper and lower proposal legends are visibly present, unobscured, with Korean glyph shapes matching supplied known labels. Flat world background, identical neutral diamonds and grid map make the composition an evident proposal rather than a game screenshot.

Native crops show complete player/target, health/resource, map/title, status and generic key-example labels. No tofu boxes, missing strokes attributable to clipping, or label/plate crossing a frame were observed. This covers the short rendered labels only, not long bindings or user-distance readability.

All four dashed border edges are visible; distinct from the solid player frame. The added frame is also explained by the lower legend. Its presence is an intentional proposal, not original screenshot evidence.
Silver upper and blue lower resource-like strips, ornamented texture and short labels remain visible. No action slots or annotation plates obscure the bars.

Full-width dark rail/dock about392px tall. Main strip sits immediately above rail; no whole-canvas enlargement or aspect squeeze is visually apparent. Exact no-resize evidence is the mechanically matched native crop, not appearance alone.

Two broad empty dark panels left of bank and one empty right chat placeholder remain. Their dividers and top/bottom edges are continuous. Shared left/middle seam is visibly broad because both4px borders meet; no lost divider observed.

Neutral square-grid map is directly right of bottom bank and left of right dark panel, separated by narrow visible gaps. Map and chat top/bottom edges align. Bank is shorter than map; utility/bag placeholders fill its lower band. Location-title and central map labels are whole.

Eleven small square/line marks followed by five larger square outlines are visible below the bank; they read as deliberately abstract placeholders, not missing glyphs. Row stays above the bottom status strip.
Winged stone creature art is exposed, with no blank box replacing it. It stands just before first main slot; approximate visible extent excludes transparent top padding in the160px placement box.

Recovered winged figure art is exposed and does not materially hide the final slot interior. Art/slot bounding boxes overlap slightly by design. It is proposed art, not a reconstruction of the source screenshot obscured ornament.

All three bank rows and both floating grids have separated frames; no merged rows, vanished cells, or displaced icon occupation was observed. Main row is continuous and not split into stacked central bars.

source_comparison.detail: World, original spells, bindings, numerical resources, chat messages and map terrain are replaced by flat/neutral/empty placeholders; no identity or functional behavior inferred.

80px logical main/bottom slots and68px floating slots are slightly smaller than original approximate82/85/70px buttons. Contained non-square recovered frame art appears about76x80 and65x68, so visible horizontal gaps are wider than nominal slot gaps. This is a logical-box versus painted-art distinction, not evidence of an accidentally scaled entire canvas.

Bottom bank is668x248 rather than original observed712x263. It ends about104px from bottom instead of94px; utility/bag strip occupies the space. Its right edge/map start shift left while bank->map->chat order remains.

Straight neutral gray4px borders look brighter/flatter and the shared seam more prominent than original dark beveled panel edges. This is visibly an approximation, consistent with notes that exact Devil2 eight-segment game edges were not rendered.
Second target frame is added at right with dashed cue. Original image establishes only one large unit frame and does not establish its exact player/target identity.

Left/right recovered art is clearly present but not pixel-perfect with original visible silhouette/size. Original right art was partially occluded; source fidelity cannot be certified for its hidden extent.

Source party-like tile, right meter overlay, top status icons, clipped side handle and dense status/message content are not present in this core preview. Reserved cast/totem/proc regions are not depicted as functioning features.

visible_error_conclusion: No definite clipped label, missing glyph, vanished asset, lost row/divider or control-covering overlay was observed in these frozen PNGs within assigned scope. Logical slot metrics must not be presented as exact painted frame dimensions.
black_feel_assessment: The source lower concentration, dark dock, long button row, triangular frame accents, silver/blue unit bars and stone ornaments remain recognizable. Neutral contents, flat world and brighter simpler panel borders make this an intentional schematic proposal rather than a pixel-perfect source reproduction.
